subject: english
stem: Sam arrives at 13:00 without registering for the 14:30 cooking class. Can Sam join?
options: No, because the Rice Box costs $6.
No, registration was required before noon.
Yes, because the class starts later.
Yes, because Room 1 is open at 13:00.

optionRationales.reason: No, because the Rice Box costs $6.：價格不是報名條件。
No, registration was required before noon.：雖尚未到 14:30，但登記截止已過。
Yes, because the class starts later.：忽略 before noon 截止。
Yes, because Room 1 is open at 13:00.：13:00 是 English 且房間不同。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「主表或圖表提供的數值與 NOTE 限制同時套用後只剩一個可行方案」可推出 No, registration was required before noon.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 No, registration was required before noon. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
